usage: Commands are argument lists. Replace uppercase input names with your own paths or identifiers. Guide paths are relative to the repository root.

install.dependency: Latest stable NARestraints from the laboratory GitHub release

optional_extra.topology: Gemmi for crystal images and coordinate mmCIF inspection

upgrade_editable_topology.working_directory: repository root after updating the checkout
upgrade_editable_topology.effect: Use the intended environment’s Python to install Gemmi and register the sticky-end inspector. Keep the recorded provider environment for historical checked runs.

molecular_replacement.result: Freezes inputs in a numbered run and launches Phenix Phaser. Omitting --execute prepares the run only.

model_preparation.result: Prepares an accepted solution using the recorded construct, supported Coot mutations, NARestraints and Phenix ReadySet.

checked_chemistry.result: Checks the effective dictionaries and matching model and restraints. A qualified preparation can become a review checkpoint. Scientific support depends on the component, backbone and site.

modified_residue_catalogue.result: Surveys the supplied NARestraints workbook and component-source directory. Consult the chemistry capability table for evidence of construction or refinement.

whole_model_restraints.result: Builds pairing and chain-order stacking restraints across the supplied nucleotide model. Strand ends and actual partners still require the correct construct.

anomalous_phasing.result: Uses Phenix AutoSol on eligible nucleotide-bound iodine, bromine or selenium sites.

refinement.result: Starts from the selected checkpoint and uses the frozen observations and Free-R set. A compatible numerical pass can become current. Review children remain available for inspection.

checkpoint_list.result: Reads the recorded branches and identifies the selected checkpoint.

refinement_review.result: Checks the existing Free-R set and compares eligible refinement trials from the reviewed parent. The operator can inspect and explicitly select a candidate.

checkpoint_inspection.result: Opens the exact model and resolved map in Coot. Listing or viewing a checkpoint preserves the current selection.

sticky_end_candidates.result: Compares declared overhangs and crystal images. Candidates, contacts and alternative pairings are observations for review. Coordinates and topology stay as supplied.

crystal_phosphate_refinement.result: Fits the declared O3′–P bonds and their crossing angles and torsions using chemically matching intact links. A later round requires a fresh native chemistry receipt for the written parent.

campaign.result: Runs or resumes datasets from an existing frozen campaign plan, one at a time. The configured stage endpoint and review state determine where each stops.

deposition_checks.result: Compares ordinary backbone steps and declared symmetry links with the coordinates returned by wwPDB. The separate deposition-geometry command remeasures bond and angle findings from a validation-data CIF.

historical_replay.requirements: Use the recorded compiler and workbook for a historical explicit NARestraints recipe. Fresh installations use the latest stable release.

sulfur_link_measurement.result: Per-model distances, angles and ordered hand of a declared phosphorothioate in its crystal image. Exit 2 marks an unresolved reading.

separate_branch_work.willow: Advanced ASU recutting, diagnosis and backbone export
